content: Study hard what interests you the most in the most undisciplined, irreverent and original manner possible.
author: Richard Feynman
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

In Richard Feynman's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
